item.title: Test fixture – Azure Virtual Machines – connectivity issues in South Central US and East US 2
item.description:
Impact Statement: Starting at 12:40 UTC on 13 Nov 2026, a subset of customers using Virtual Machines in South Central US and East US 2 may experience intermittent connectivity failures.

Current Status: Engineers are investigating. The next update will be provided within 60 minutes.

item.title: Test fixture – Azure Storage – West Europe
item.description: Between 02:10 and 03:45 UTC, customers in West Europe may have seen elevated latency. This issue has been mitigated.
